# Areia Soft

> Areia Soft is a software development company providing custom software development, website development, web application development, mobile application development, ERP and CRM solutions, eCommerce development, UI/UX design, AI automation, cloud and DevOps, API integration, software maintenance, and digital transformation services for businesses worldwide.

## Company

* Name: Areia Soft
* Website: https://www.areiasoft.com
* Type: Software Development Company
* Service Area: Worldwide
* Primary Focus: Custom Software Development and Digital Solutions

## Core Services

* [Website Development](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/website-development): Custom, responsive and SEO-friendly website development for businesses and organizations.
* [Custom Software Development](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/custom-software-development): Scalable software solutions designed around business processes and workflows.
* [Web Application Development](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/web-application-development): Secure and scalable web applications, SaaS platforms, portals and dashboards.
* [Mobile App Development](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/mobile-app-development): Android and iOS mobile application development.
* [ERP & CRM Solutions](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/erp-crm-solutions): Custom ERP and CRM software for business operations, customers, sales and reporting.
* [eCommerce Development](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/ecommerce-development): Custom online stores and eCommerce platforms with product, payment, inventory and order management.
* [UI/UX Design](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/ui-ux-design): User-centered design for websites, mobile applications and SaaS products.
* [AI & Automation Solutions](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/ai-automation-solutions): AI software, intelligent automation, chatbots and AI integrations.
* [Cloud & DevOps Solutions](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/cloud-devops-solutions): Cloud infrastructure, AWS, Docker, CI/CD, deployment and monitoring.
* [API Development & Integration](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/api-development-integration): REST API development and third-party system integrations.
* [Software Maintenance & Support](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/software-maintenance-support): Software maintenance, bug fixing, security updates, optimization and technical support.
* [Digital Transformation](https://www.areiasoft.com/service/digital-transformation): Business modernization, workflow automation, cloud adoption and system integration.
